title: bot.behavior.create
description: Create a new behavior. Select names it and says what it does (intent only); the builder then writes its SCXML program from the intent and this turn. A turn behavior (default) answers one matching turn; a persistent routine keeps running on every / at schedules (delayed sends) across turns and restarts, for recurring or time-based needs or when the user asked for something recurring.

name.description: Stable PascalCase behavior name to install.
name.title: Name

triggers.description: Stimulus event names whose turns this behavior answers (a turn behavior); a routine needs none.
triggers.title: Triggers

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the behavior does, shown in inventory and reflection. The install keeps the caller-supplied description when present.
examples: Say hello when a knock sound arrives.
description.title: Description

reason.description: Why this behavior is being installed now: the observed pattern across recent episodes that justifies it. Recorded for reflection, never dispatched.
examples: Same knock→greeting pattern across recent episodes.
reason.title: Reason

example.description: For a turn behavior: one message the behavior must answer, written as the user would say it (for 'when I say ping, say pong': ping). The behavior is run on it before it is accepted and must handle it. Null for a routine.
example.title: Example

source.description: Leave null: the builder writes the program.
source.title: Source

examples.description: Say hello when a knock sound arrives.
examples.name: GreetOnKnock
examples.reason: Same knock→greeting pattern across recent episodes.

examples.description: Persistent routine: brief the user at 08:00 on weekdays.
examples.name: MorningBriefing
examples.reason: The user asked to hear a briefing every weekday morning.
